invariants.rationale: The method always returns a newly constructed HoodieJavaWriteClient, which should never be null.
The new HoodieJavaWriteClient is constructed with config, so getConfig() should return the same object reference.
The new HoodieJavaWriteClient is constructed with context, so getEngineContext() should return the same object reference.
The object returned is explicitly an instance of HoodieJavaWriteClient.
config is required to construct the HoodieJavaWriteClient, so result.getConfig() should not be null.
